LESSON: SIGN READING 3.2.1 PRINT AWARENESS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.2: Sign reading 3.2.1 Print awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign reading 3.2.1 Print awareness, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do you enjoy reading pictures? 2. Which pictures do you enjoy reading? 3. Which things found in the school can you draw?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign reading 3.2.1 Print awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and communication: Teamwork as learner with others read pictures and picture stories in group.

● Self-efficacy: as learner correctly identifies pictures and is appreciated.

Values:
● Respect: Patience as learner takes turns in talking about the school related pictures.

● Unity: Non discrimination as learners work together in talking about the pictures.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Child Safety and security as learner identifies safe and unsafe places in to avoid playing around in and out of school.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Environmental activities as the learner read pictures of different things found in the environment.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Adapted course book, pictures, charts, video recordings, manual alphabet chart, pictures, realia, online resources
